messages:
pagerduty-bot: URGENT: PagerDuty PD-7149 triggered for region sw-us1 — elevated gateway 5xx rate (alert: gateway_5xx_rate > 5% for 3m). Paging on-call SRE.

maya: I'm on it — seeing 502 + 504 spikes from edge-proxy pool egress-12. KV cache miss rate jumped ~4x around the same time.

liam: Confirmed on dashboards: https://grafana.redwood/internal/d/egress-sw-us1 (link). p95 latency up, and a lot of backend 502s.

oncall-sre: Joining. Pulling logs now. Filter: `service:gateway region:sw-us1 level:ERROR`

ops-bot: Deploys paused in sw-us1 by deploy-sentry (reason: elevated error rate).

maya: Quick mitigation proposal (runbook-lite):
1) Shift 30% of sw-us1 egress traffic to us-west-2 as an immediate relief.
2) Temporarily relax circuit breaker open threshold to 10% for 2m to prevent aggressive evictions.
3) Scale egress-pool-12 +4 instances and enable prefix /kv cache retention bump.

liam: Initiating route shift (30% to usw2):
```
# run locally in ops namespace
./ops/route-shift --from sw-us1 --to usw2 --percent 30 --note "PD-7149 rapid evac"
```

liam: route-shift logs:
```
2026-03-15T22:10:12Z route-shift: started
2026-03-15T22:10:16Z routing-change: pushed to global-router
2026-03-15T22:10:18Z verify: 30% traffic now directed to usw2
```

maya: KV cache config patch (applied):
```
kubectl patch configmap kvcache -n edge --type merge -p '{"data":{"ttl":"900"}}'
```

oncall-sre: Health check on fallback endpoints: `curl -sS https://fallback.redwood.net/health | jq .` -> {"status":"ok"}

ops-bot: Fallback routing enabled, traffic steering in effect.

customer-success: Noting customer impact — early telemetry shows ~18% 5xx for affected tenants in sw-us1, but globally it's ~2% of total traffic. I'll prep a short status note for CSMs.

maya: Current observed numbers: sw-us1 5xx = 12.7% peak -> after route shift down to 3.2%. Overall p95 latency for sw-us1 went from 480ms -> 220ms.

liam: Investigating root: loadbalancer health probes to backend were 100ms probes, backend burst caused transient failures and LB ejection. Also saw KV cache cold-starts after a rapid scale event.

oncall-sre: Draining one of the noisy pods to stop noisy neighbor: `kubectl drain egress-12-0 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` — kicked off.

maya: Running quick synthetic checks against a set of customer routes. Sample results:
```
200 OK x 90
502 x 10
504 x 0
avg latency 210ms
```

liam: After drain + route shift + cache bump, sw-us1 5xx trending down to 0.8% over 20m. Still watching for >=1% persistence.

pagerduty-bot: Reminder: escalation window — if gateway_5xx_rate > 5% for 10m escalate to ENG-LEAD.

oncall-sre: We're handing off to night SRE (nora) in ~25m. Nora, pls ack and take watch after that.

nora: Ack — I'll take watch at handoff. Have runbooks and contact list.

customer-success: Draft status for customers (to be sent after stabilization):
"We experienced elevated 5xx errors in our Southwest region. Traffic has been rerouted while we mitigate root causes. No customer data loss is expected. We'll follow up with a post-incident summary."

maya: Post-incident action items (owners):
- SRE (maya): postmortem + timeline + transient cache warmup analysis.
- NetEng (liam): LB probe tuning + ejection policy change.
- Infra (oncall-sre): verify autoscaler behavior that caused cold cache churn.

liam: Temporary measures we took: route shift to usw2, increased egress pool size, KV TTL bump, drained noisy pod, and paused deploys in sw-us1.

oncall-sre: Incident classification: P1 until 5xx < 1% for 30m and customers confirm improvement.

pagerduty-bot: Current metrics snapshot: sw-us1 5xx=0.8% (35m post-start), global impact <1%. PD alert will remain open until someone marks mitigated.

maya: Marking as MITIGATED in PD (will close in 10m if stable). Thanks all — great coordination. :thumbsup: :raised_hands:

nora: Taking over watch. I'll post updates every 15m until PD closed.

customer-success: Once PD is closed, we'll schedule customer comms and include the ETA for remediation.

maya: Logged notes for postmortem: potential root cause = LB healthcheck window too aggressive + cache TTL churn after autoscaler spike -> compounding effect under burst.

liam: I'll prep LB probe PR and test in staging tomorrow.

oncall-sre: Closing tasks for live mitigation. Handing to follow-up owners.

pagerduty-bot: PD-7149 status changed to MITIGATED by maya at 2026-03-15T22:54:05Z.
